title: From Morality Installation in LLMs to LLMs in Morality-as-a-System

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes a conceptual framework for auditing cross-component cultural homogenisation, such as measuring the KL divergence between the distribution of culturally specific moral markers at the pre-training stage and the alignment stage.

Proposes using representation engineering to track whether the geometric direction associated with a protected-group attribute drifts closer to a direction encoding negative evaluative valence across successive fine-tuning events.
